text: Level three, question six: A and B invest sixty thousand and forty thousand rupees; A, the working partner, gets ten percent of the profit for managing, and the rest is shared in the ratio of capitals; A receives fourteen thousand rupees more than B; find the total profit. Question seven: A, B and C invest one lakh, one lakh fifty thousand and two lakh fifty thousand rupees; C, the working partner, gets three thousand rupees a month; the year's profit is one lakh thirty-six thousand; find C's total. Question eight: A invests forty thousand rupees for twelve months and B invests sixty thousand for eight months; A manages the business and gets twenty percent of the profit, and the rest is shared in the ratio of capital times time; A receives thirty-three thousand rupees in all; find the total profit and B's share.
